title: Demo: Instrument transport and step sequencer shell, proven on Granular
description:
Sources: docs/decisions/0020-halloween-demo-slicer-and-sequencers.md items 2, 4, 5, 7, 8 and 16 to 18; spec/product/control-map.md C-072 to C-077; docs/decisions/0021-instrument-engines-and-performance-views.md items 7 to 10 (Proposed; product shape, not settled by the demo).

Scope
Step 2 of 0020's delivery order. One Instrument transport (BPM, run/stop) kept across engine and view switches; no swing. A 16-step sequencer on the OLED: Encoder 0 browses steps, a press edits one, Encoder 0 turns its value, Encoder 1 button toggles the step on or off. Each engine keeps its own pattern. Granular binding: a step's value is a clip position; grains continue between steps; an off step keeps the previous position; the live position knob offsets the sequence instead of overriding it. Portable logic (transport clock, step stepping, offset rule) goes in Common/ with host tests; the OLED view and wiring are demo-only behind the Demo preset. Do not touch the matrix: Granular keeps the p04.7 grain-activity view.
acceptance_criteria: Host tests: transport timing at several BPM values, step advance and wrap, off-step hold, knob offset applied and clamped; Debug, Release and Demo build; on hardware the Granular sequence plays at the set BPM, step edits are audible, the transport survives a page switch and the audio-callback budget stays within the p04.7 measurement. Evidence in docs/evidence/. Notes appended to v7l.1.
notes: 2026-10-06: use 0021 item 7's provisional transport controls in the demo: Encoder 0 click on the Granular (main engine) page runs or stops the transport; Encoder 2 click does it inside the step view, where Encoder 0 click selects a step. The engine-drive setting (0021 item 12) is not built for the demo: the sequencer always sends value and trigger.

title: Decide 0020: Halloween demo Instrument scope (Slicer, sequencers, tempo matrix)
description: Draft: docs/decisions/0020-halloween-demo-slicer-and-sequencers.md on branch claude/instrument-design-decisions. Extends the demo to Granular + Slicer with a sequencer view each; supersedes 0011 item 16 and the checkpoint 3 fallback. Work through the record's (agent) items and Open questions with the user, then the user accepts or rejects. Freeze is 2026-10-21, so this decision is the most urgent.
acceptance_criteria: User accepts or rejects 0020; on acceptance, demo implementation tasks are proposed under p04 and p04.7 is amended (drop slices from Common/granular.h, hue-rotation matrix).
notes: 2026-10-05: all 0020 open questions and (agent) items resolved with the user and written into the draft on claude/instrument-design-decisions: delivery order kept (step 2 = transport + sequencer shell proven on Granular); matrix per engine (Granular keeps p04.7 grain activity, Slicer gets the per-bar hue rotation, dark with no clip, no EMF, M3 replaced: Instrument never records in the demo); slice-page cut order length, audition, gate, level, pitch, slice count (floor: 16 fixed slices + sequencer); checkpoint 2 gate (Granular on hardware by 10-14), Slicer starts only after step 2 is on hardware, freeze carries last hardware-proven step; empty state = existing p04.6 NO CLIP screen, load failure still returns to Field. Remaining: user accepts or rejects 0020; on acceptance remove the Open questions section, set Accepted, propose the three demo tasks, amend p04.7 acceptance criteria.
close_reason: User accepted decision 0020 on 2026-10-05 (claude/instrument-design-decisions). Demo tasks created: full_spooky_proto-p04.14 (transport and sequencer shell on Granular), full_spooky_proto-p04.15 (Slicer engine, page, hue matrix), full_spooky_proto-p04.16 (Slicer sequencer); p04.7 amended.

title: Granular voice with provisional Instrument pages
description:
Sources: docs/decisions/0011-halloween-2026-demo-build.md; docs/decisions/0020-halloween-demo-slicer-and-sequencers.md items 1, 6 and 13; spec/product/roadmap.md Demo track item 16; spec/product/modes-and-interaction.md Granular

Scope
Portable granular core in Common/ (start of v7l.1) feeding the monitor path; the core carries no slice parameter (0020 item 6). Provisional demo-only pages that do not settle C-025: page 1 position, grain size, density, pitch on Encoders 0-3; page 2 (C-024) spray, envelope, level, with the former slice-quantization slot unassigned. Button 1 unbound in Instrument. Matrix shows grain activity, not EMF (kept by 0020 item 13).
acceptance_criteria: Host tests: known-sample output, bounded grain count, underrun counter; Common/Inc/granular.h has no slices field; on hardware pages 1-2 work, the grain-activity matrix follows the grains, audio-callback work measured and bounded; note appended to v7l.1.
notes:
2026-10-05: proposed decision 0020 () would drop slice quantization from Granular and replace the grain-activity matrix with a BPM hue rotation. Before merging p04.7: Common/Inc/granular.h carries 'slices' in the portable core (start of v7l.1), which 0021 rejects for the product engine. Hold or amend p04.7 per 0020's outcome.
Correction to the previous note: the 0020 decision task is full_spooky_proto-p04.13.
2026-10-05: correction to the first note: the empty '()' should read (docs/decisions/0020-halloween-demo-slicer-and-sequencers.md). 0020 now keeps the grain-activity matrix for Granular (the hue rotation is Slicer-only), so the only change p04.7 needs before merge is dropping 'slices' from Common/Inc/granular.h, page 2 and the tests. The user agreed this (G1), so it does not have to wait for 0020's acceptance.
2026-10-05: 0020 accepted. Description and acceptance criteria amended: slice quantization removed (0020 item 6), grain-activity matrix kept (item 13). Granular on hardware is the 2026-10-14 checkpoint gate (item 16). Next: full_spooky_proto-p04.14.

title: Propose the spec/product changes from decisions 0021-0024 as one set
description:
Sources: the "Product document changes on acceptance" sections of docs/decisions/0021 to 0024 (claude/instrument-design-decisions).

Scope

title: Demo: Slicer sequencer view
description:
Sources: docs/decisions/0020-halloween-demo-slicer-and-sequencers.md items 3, 5, 7 and 9; docs/decisions/0022-slicer-engine.md items 10 and 11 (Proposed).

Scope
Bind the sequencer shell to the Slicer: a step's value is a slice; the pattern starts as identity and is edited on the OLED with the shared step view; the Slicer pattern is kept separately from Granular's. When the slice count changes, steps remap by 0022 item 11 if it has been decided by then; otherwise reset to the identity pattern and record that choice in the evidence. Portable remap logic goes in Common/ with host tests.
acceptance_criteria: Host tests: step value range follows the slice count, remap (or reset) on count change, patterns kept per engine; Debug, Release and Demo build; on hardware an edited Slicer pattern rearranges the clip audibly and survives a switch to Granular and back. Evidence in docs/evidence/.

title: Demo: Slicer engine with its slice page and hue-rotation matrix
description:
Sources: docs/decisions/0020-halloween-demo-slicer-and-sequencers.md items 3, 9 to 13 and 17; docs/decisions/0022-slicer-engine.md items 1 to 9 (Proposed; product shape, not settled by the demo).

Scope
Step 3 of 0020's delivery order; starts only after the transport and sequencer shell runs on hardware (0020 item 17). Slicer as a second engine switched with the engine selector (C-018 to C-020; provisional, does not settle D-005); only one engine runs at a time. On load: 16 equal slices, identity pattern, BPM set so the clip spans one bar. One voice; a new step cuts the previous slice with a short crossfade; a slice plays until its end or the next step; no time-stretch. Render inside the existing 1.5 ms radio-interrupt budget. Slicer page: slice count (4, 8, 16) at engine level; Encoder 0 selects a slice, a press opens pitch (rate change), gate, level and length. Cut order if time runs short: length editing, audition on select, gate, level, pitch, slice count; the floor is 16 fixed slices with the sequencer alone. Matrix while Slicer is active: one solid color through the spectrum, one cycle per bar, frozen while stopped, dark with no clip, no EMF. Slice map type and render core are portable in Common/ with host tests; page, matrix and wiring are demo-only behind the Demo preset.
acceptance_criteria: Host tests: slice map invariants (no gaps or overlap, minimum length if length editing ships), identity pattern on load, crossfade cut, bounded render work; Debug, Release and Demo build; on hardware a loaded clip first sounds like itself looping, the slice page controls that shipped work, the hue matrix tracks the bar and freezes on stop, and the render stays within budget. Evidence in docs/evidence/. Record which page controls were cut.

title: Decide 0023: clip selection, region editing and the empty Instrument
description: Draft: docs/decisions/0023-clip-selection-and-region-editing.md on branch claude/instrument-design-decisions. Shift+Enc1 Load clip (new C-112), auto-open when no clip, browser reuse with caller-specific action, select-audition-confirm activation, region editor (Enc0 move window, Enc1 start, Enc2 end, Enc3 resolution), no-clip and failure behavior. Open: whether to keep a dedicated start control alongside window move.
acceptance_criteria: User accepts or rejects 0023; control-map change proposal presented for approval.
notes: 2026-10-06: worked through with the user. All agent items and open questions resolved in the draft: region editor control table (Enc0 slide/audition/Load-Replace hold, Enc1 start/previous event, Enc2 end/next event, Enc3 zoom/finer step/back), waveform+event timeline from a stored peak track (note on hpq.3), event jumps with pre-roll, zoom-linked step, clamp at max length, 250 ms minimum, re-edit via the same Shift+Enc1 gesture, empty state and failures, C-010 failure stays in Field, clip selection rejected during a session, clip = asset ID + window. Awaiting acceptance.

title: Decide 0022: Slicer engine (slice map, slice page, sequencer)
description: Draft: docs/decisions/0022-slicer-engine.md on branch claude/instrument-design-decisions. Slice map with custom boundaries, per-slice pitch/gate/level/length, confirmed slice-count change, time-based step remap. Slicer is post-M5 product scope; needs a roadmap proposal to place it.
acceptance_criteria: User accepts or rejects 0022 and its open questions are resolved or carried as named follow-ups.
notes:
2026-10-06: 0021 item 19 gives the Slicer MIDI key map direction (one slice per note from base note 36, velocity to level, one-shot default or gated note-off, out-of-range notes ignored, one voice). Write its detail into 0022 when that record is worked through.
2026-10-06: worked through with the user. Agreed: items 7-9 and 11 (min length, audition when stopped, confirmed count change, time-based remap); new items 13-20: disabled slice silent; slice map in the Slicer preset with clip reference, boundaries reset on new clip; pitch by rate, +/-12 st; start editable, Sound and Boundaries pages; gate as fraction of slice; extras order probability+ratchets then reverse; shuffle as a sequencer-shell action; MIDI key map from 0021 item 19. Per-slice source overrides moved to 0024. Remaining: user confirms probability/ratchet/editing details (item 18) and shuffle details (item 19), then accepts.

title: Decide 0021: Instrument engines own their performance-view semantics
description: Draft: docs/decisions/0021-instrument-engines-and-performance-views.md on branch claude/instrument-design-decisions. Granular/Slicer/One-shot as separate engines, one at a time, shared view shell, OLED-only editing. Many open questions (matrix in Instrument, macros/modulation/FX ownership, One-shot MIDI path, roadmap placement). Includes proposed changes to protected spec/product docs, which need separate approval.
acceptance_criteria: User accepts or rejects 0021; product-doc change proposals presented for approval; Granular feature spec via /speckit-specify proposed as the next step.
notes:
2026-10-06: open questions worked through with the user on claude/instrument-design-decisions. Agreed: transport run/stop on Encoder 0 click (main engine page, echoes C-103); matrix body engine-owned with shared recording ring and EMF-when-routed (0019 outline); shared modulation sources, engine-owned targets, per-engine macro slots; one global FX chain excluded from engine presets (resolves D-008); tempo+swing global, division/length/scale per pattern; sequencer doubles as stepped mod source with a standard primary-routing toggle, p-locks deferred; Instrument recording = rendered mix + event metadata; One-shot MIDI and mic injection deferred to engine records; roadmap After-M5 line proposed. Remaining: Sequencer-view transport control, confirm item 6 gesture list and item 12 routing-off behavior, then accept.
2026-10-06: remaining questions answered: Encoder 2 click runs/stops the transport inside performance views (Encoder 0 click on the main engine page), provisional; item 6 gesture list confirmed; engine drive setting with value-and-trigger (default), trigger-only and none. No open questions remain; awaiting acceptance.
2026-10-06: added External MIDI items 18-20 at the user's request: every engine playable from MIDI notes, none dependent on it; key-map directions (Slicer one slice per note from note 36, one-shot or gated note-off; Granular pitch key map by default with position as alternative, mono legato first; One-shot chromatic); sequencer and MIDI both fire the engine, latest wins on one voice; MIDI velocity/CC/mod wheel/aftertouch as shared mod sources. MIDI input path moves to its own shared-infrastructure record. Still awaiting acceptance.
close_reason: User accepted decision 0021 on 2026-10-06 (claude/instrument-design-decisions). Its proposed changes to spec/product/ documents will be drafted as one proposal with 0022-0024's.

title: Define versioned session, asset and recovery formats
description:
Sources: spec/product/modes-and-interaction.md Recording/Playback; docs/history/2026-09-23-repository-review.md milestone 5; workbook D-009

Scope
Choose stems/container and manifest/event/EMF formats, stable asset IDs and timestamp origin. Define incomplete/recovered state and firmware/renderer version; preserve current 3-channel WAV regression.

Acceptance Criteria
Example valid/incomplete manifests, forward compatibility and recovery rules documented; sample references and missing-source behavior defined; format supports synchronized nondestructive playback.
acceptance_criteria: Example valid/incomplete manifests, forward compatibility and recovery rules documented; sample references and missing-source behavior defined; format supports synchronized nondestructive playback.
notes:
From behavior model 54w.13 (docs/design/behavior/session.md, Open behavior): decide whether Reviewing is a Session state entered while the Playback utility is open, or only a Context concern. The constitution lists reviewing as a session state; product intent makes Playback a utility space.
2026-09-28 (decision 0006, Proposed): session.md is deleted by 8lw.14; session-state references move to docs/design/behavior/SessionSm.puml.
2026-09-28 (8lw.14): session.md is deleted. Its open questions (Reviewing, session folder and manifest) are notes in docs/design/behavior/SessionSm.puml pointing here; the cross-region session invariants are DEV-I3 to DEV-I5 in top-level.md.
2026-09-28 (decision 0008 item 4): with session folders, a session continues into the next file at the 4 GiB WAV limit without a gap in either track.
2026-10-06 (decision 0023 item 21, Proposed, claude/instrument-design-decisions): the session and capture formats must store a peak track for the clip region editor's waveform timeline: min and max per 256-sample block (about 5 ms) per track (radio, microphone), about 1.4 MB per track per hour, with coarser levels derived from it; computed from recorder blocks outside interrupt context; aligned to the same sample timeline as the 0010 item 2 sidecars, including rolling captures. Recordings without it are scanned once while no session records and the result cached. Clips reference recordings by stable asset ID plus a window in samples (0023 item 20).
